mapper.select: SELECT a.defect_id, a.device_id, b.device_name, a.std_mete_id, d.mete_name, a.defect_time, a.deal_time, a.defect_type, e.dict_note as defect_type_name, a.conf_mode, f.dict_note as conf_mode_name, a.image_path, a.deal_info, a.deal_type, g.dict_note as deal_type_name, a.deal_person_id, h.user_name as deal_person_name, a.defect_content FROM t_defect_info a LEFT JOIN t_std_device b on a.device_id = b.device_id and a.cunstom_id = b.custom_id LEFT JOIN t_std_mete d on a.std_mete_id = d.std_mete_id LEFT JOIN t_dict_business e on a.defect_type = e.dict_code LEFT JOIN t_dict_business f on a.conf_mode = f.dict_code LEFT JOIN t_dict_business g on a.deal_type = g.dict_code LEFT JOIN sys_user h on a.deal_person_id = h.user_id WHERE 1 = 1 and device_name like concat("%",#{deviceName, jdbcType=VARCHAR},"%") and defect_type = #{defectType, jdbcType=INTEGER} and conf_mode = #{confMode, jdbcType=INTEGER} and defect_time BETWEEN #{startTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND #{endTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT( defect_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ) as time_node, count( * ) as count FROM ( select a.defect_time from t_defect_info a where 1=1 ) AS Time WHERE period_diff( date_format( now( ) , '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%S' ) , date_format( defect_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%S' ) ) =0 and DATE_FORMAT( defect_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%S' ) BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} GROUP BY time_node

SELECT a.processed as '已处理', b.untreated as '未处理' FROM ( (select count(conf_mode = 275 or null) as processed from t_defect_info ) a, (select count(conf_mode = 276 or null) as untreated from t_defect_info ) b )
